subject: English
passage: After California implemented a statewide carbon tax on major industrial facilities in 2013, greenhouse gas emissions dropped by nearly forty ______ policies often encounter what researchers call the "adaptation effect": as companies adjust their operations, emission reductions tend to plateau over time.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
